description: Full-text search US state (and federal) legislation to find out what bills are about a given topic. Searches one state or nationwide (ALL) and returns matching bills with number, title, state, last action, and a LegiScan bill_id you can pass to get_bill. Example: search_bills({ query: "data privacy", state: "CA" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own LegiScan API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

state.description: 2-letter state abbreviation (e.g. "CA", "TX") or "ALL" to search every state. Default "ALL".

year.description: LegiScan year code: 1 = all years, 2 = current + prior session (default), or a specific year like 2024.

name: search_bills
title: Search Bills
